tooltip.cobblemonranger.styler_hint: Use on a wild Pokémon to capture, or on an obstacle for a field move. Sneak-use to release friends.
tooltip.cobblemonranger.module_hint: Apply to a styler at a smithing table
screen.cobblemonranger.hint: Hold left click and draw loops around the Pokémon. Don't let it touch the line! Esc to give up.
message.cobblemonranger.not_wild: Only wild Pokémon can be captured with a styler.
message.cobblemonranger.in_battle: That Pokémon is in a battle.
message.cobblemonranger.busy: A capture is already in progress.
message.cobblemonranger.no_energy: Your styler is out of energy. It recharges over time, or repair it with redstone at an anvil.
message.cobblemonranger.party_full: Your party is full, so there's no room for a friend Pokémon.
message.cobblemonranger.capture_failed_e: Your styler ran out of energy and the Pokémon got away!
message.cobblemonranger.capture_escaped: %s got away before the capture finished.
message.cobblemonranger.captured: Capture complete! %s will help you as a friend Pokémon until your next battle is over.
message.cobblemonranger.release_in_battl: You can't release friends during a battle.
message.cobblemonranger.battle_over: Thanks for the help! %s is heading home.
message.cobblemonranger.friend_hint: %s is your friend Pokémon. Sneak and use the styler in the air to send your friends home.
message.cobblemonranger.styler_level_up: Your styler reached Lv. %s! Energy, line length and loop power went up.
screen.cobblemonranger.hint_assist: Draw loops around the Pokémon. Click a Pokémon below or press its number for a Poké Assist. Esc to give up.
message.cobblemonranger.assist_used: %s lent a Poké Assist, then went back to the wild.
message.cobblemonranger.partner_set: %s is now your Partner Pokémon! It will follow you, power up Poké Assists and help with field moves.
message.cobblemonranger.partner_missing: Your Partner Pokémon isn't in your party. Put it back in your party to have it with you.
message.cobblemonranger.no_partner: You have no Partner Pokémon. Send out one of your own Pokémon and use the styler on it to choose it.
message.cobblemonranger.partner_cleared: You no longer have a Partner Pokémon.
message.cobblemonranger.field_move_no_he: None of your friends can use %s. Capture a %s-type Pokémon first.
message.cobblemonranger.field_move_no_en: %s needs more styler energy to use %s.
message.cobblemonranger.field_move_frien: %s used %s, then went back to the wild.
message.cobblemonranger.sign_need_styler: You need a Capture Styler to draw Ranger Signs.
message.cobblemonranger.sign_locked: You need to be Ranger rank %2$s to use the %1$s.
message.cobblemonranger.sign_cooldown: The %s needs %s more seconds to recharge.
message.cobblemonranger.sign_no_energy: Your styler needs at least 10 energy for a Ranger Sign.
message.cobblemonranger.sign_celebi: Celebi made %s plants around you grow.
message.cobblemonranger.sign_suicune: Suicune purified you and healed your party.
message.cobblemonranger.sign_entei: Entei's Sacred Fire hit %s hostile mobs.
message.cobblemonranger.sign_groudon: Groudon made the sun come out.
message.cobblemonranger.sign_unlocked: New Ranger Sign: %s! Press the Ranger Sign key (G by default) and draw it.
screen.cobblemonranger.sign_hint: Hold left click and draw a sign in one stroke. Esc to close.
screen.cobblemonranger.sign_unknown: That sign wasn't recognised. Try again!
screen.cobblemonranger.sign_locked: You need to be Ranger rank %s to use that sign.
mission.cobblemonranger.capture: Capture %s wild Pokémon with your styler
message.cobblemonranger.mission_reward: Reward: %s emeralds, %s styler XP, %s Ranger points
message.cobblemonranger.mission_accepted: Mission accepted: %s. Report back to %s when you're done.
message.cobblemonranger.mission_no_offer: Nobody is offering you a mission right now. Use a styler on a Ranger at a Ranger HQ terminal to ask for one.
message.cobblemonranger.mission_already: You already have a mission. Finish or abandon it first.
message.cobblemonranger.mission_busy: You're already on a mission for %s: %s. Use /ranger mission abandon to drop it.
message.cobblemonranger.mission_none: %s has no new missions yet. Come back in a little while.
message.cobblemonranger.mission_done: Mission complete! Report back to %s for your reward.
message.cobblemonranger.mission_complete: %s thanks you! You got %s emeralds and %s Ranger points.
message.cobblemonranger.mission_not_rang: %s doesn't hand out missions. Find a Ranger at a Ranger HQ terminal.
message.cobblemonranger.mission_tier_cap: This Ranger has %s missions, but you need a higher Ranger rank for them.
message.cobblemonranger.tier_unlocked: Rangers can now give you missions up to %s level.
message.cobblemonranger.hq_level_up: %s reached %s level and has tougher missions with bigger rewards!
message.cobblemonranger.no_mission: You have no mission. Use a styler on a Ranger at a Ranger HQ terminal to ask for one.
message.cobblemonranger.rank_up: Ranger rank up! You are now rank %s: %s
message.cobblemonranger.rank_info: Ranger rank %s: %s. %s points (next rank at %s), %s missions done.
